goal: Server provides MEF; rules and executable behavior are MEF development; prefer available Client/native offload. No official-MEF restoration prerequisite.

proposed_observer_contract.policy: Default defeat-only closure; existing Server WaveCleared implementation remains unchanged.
rules: pending or failed spawn never counts as defeated
ignore repeated event_id for same member lifetime
cancel/despawn not defeat unless content explicitly chooses it
clear once when every current member is terminal for a counted reason
